ops.title: prSquashesOnBase walks a bounded window, not grep matches (v0.79.25)
ops.body: git log -N caps output, not commits walked; combined with --grep it walked the whole trunk for an absent PR (Oct 19: ccx stack submit held 70% of a core for 22s on monorepo dev). Since #426 (06de081, v0.79.25) prSquashesOnBase reads the newest 200*len(numbers) commits with no --grep and filters subjects in Go. Squashes older than the window are not found: resolveQueueLandings, reviews, and status fall back to the Graphite queue comment; prune does not (task 4c1b656). Never reintroduce --grep with -N as a lookback bound. Evidence: /Users/yasyf/.local/state/host-pressure-recovery/runs/20261019T014936-oneoff/ccx-prlanding-shipped.json
